title: PCBI_V1_3_1_METHODOLOGY_GOVERNANCE
description: Methodology governance architecture prohibiting unapproved mathematical adjustments and enforcing Module 2 classification authority.

module2AuthorityMandate.rule: Module 2 remains the ONLY classification authority. Module 3 MUST NOT independently classify customer materials based on keyword searches, description matching, AI inference, or commodity assumptions.

hardValidation.condition: IF Module 3 classification conflicts with Module 2 classification

mandatoryPrerequisites.requirement: Governance committee approval record exists (status = APPROVED)
Source and provenance audit record verified
